hook: IC 1101 is the most extended galaxy in the Universe, but how big is it?

sections.voiceover: IC 1101 is the most extended galaxy in the Universe, but how big is it?

sections.voiceover: On October 2, 2026, the Instituto de Astrofísica de Canarias released a study of IC 1101. How large is it?

sections.voiceover: The Instituto de Astrofísica de Canarias team used ultra-deep imaging to define its physical limits.

sections.voiceover: Carlos Marrero-de la Rosa and his colleagues published these precise size constraints in Astronomy & Astrophysics. Their October 2026 study confirms IC 1101 remains the most extended galaxy in the Universe.
